messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P1 fired for customer AcmeCorp — private control plane heartbeats missing for on-prem agent 'acme-edge-23'. Link: https://pd.redwood/status/INC-2178000000 

pagerduty: Alert: P1 - AcmeCorp/private-controlplane - HEARTBEAT_MISSING
pagerduty: Triggered at 2026-03-14T09:00:00Z

maria.chen: ack'd, oncall taking

sre_oncall: I'm up — pulling logs now. Maria, can you post the customer name and region? 

maria.chen: AcmeCorp, us-east-2, agent hostname acme-edge-23, last_seen 09:00:00 UTC

jack.t: I can ssh to their management gateway, trying: 
```bash
ssh ubuntu@acme-gw.us-east-2.acmecorp.net
ssh ubuntu@acme-edge-23
``` 

sophia: seeing repeated auth failures in recent syslog: 
```
Mar 14 08:59:58 acme-edge kernel: [auth] failed to refresh token: 401 Unauthorized
Mar 14 08:59:59 acme-edge redwood-agent[2143]: heartbeat send failed: 401
``` 

maria.chen: customer reported they rotated a KMS key earlier today. Could be related. Maria @acme_support can you confirm key rotation window?

acme_support: yes, rotated keys at 08:57 UTC, replaced agent config at 08:58, we saw transient errors then. Agent restarted once by our ops.

sre_oncall: ok likely auth token rotation mismatch. Quick mitigation options: 1) push new agent config (preferred), 2) restart agent after ensuring creds, 3) fall back to hosted control plane for customer routes. Thoughts?

jack.t: pushing config now via our remote script. Running:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://mgmt.redwood.io/api/v1/agents/acme-edge-23/refresh-config \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
``` 

devops-bot: job started: config-refresh acme-edge-23 (job id: 6632)

devops-bot: job succeeded: config-refresh acme-edge-23 (6632) — 09:02:12 UTC

sophia: after config push, agent logs show new token accepted and heartbeat resumed: 
```
09:02:15 redwood-agent[2158]: token validated
09:02:17 redwood-agent[2158]: heartbeat ok
``` 

maria.chen: customer reports API 503s during window (08:57-09:02) — estimated impact: ~5 minutes, multiple API calls failed for their internal org tools. Any persistent errors?

sre_oncall: monitoring shows control plane heartbeat gap 09:00-09:02, no further flaps. Marking mitigation: config refresh succeeded. 

pagerduty: Escalation cleared — incident acknowledged and mitigated by oncall

maria.chen: I'll open a follow-up runbook task: ensure agent auto-reloads on key rotation with zero-downtime token refresh. Assigning to sophia.

sophia: taking runbook action. Plan: implement token watcher + prefetch and graceful reload, plus alert refinement to suppress noise during planned rotations.

jack.t: adding customer notes: AcmeCorp rotated KMS key; agent required manual config refresh due to missing prefetch. We should surface pre-rotation checklist to customers.

maria.chen: Customer-facing summary: "We observed a brief outage (≈5m) caused by an agent failing to accept rotated credentials. We pushed a config refresh and service recovered. We're implementing improvements to avoid this on future key rotations." Approve?

acme_support: approved. thanks.

sre_oncall: closing thread. tagging postmortem if recurring.

incident-bot: Incident P1 - AcmeCorp resolved; timeline and logs archived to https://incidents.redwood/internal/2178000000

maria.chen: thumbs up :thumbsup:
